title: the signal fills after the still hush
story: Losing My Way is a slow, quiet song: the pre-roll is a clean, still mint-and-plum signal (rms 0.06, bar 58-64) with only two clean tears on its loudest hits, 4782 and 4860 (14.6, 14.1). The drop lands as an rms step at 4904 (0.05 to 0.20, +1.9 sd): the scanlines thin, the brightness and contrast open, and the signal fills. After it, the kick on each dark hit punches the zoom and lifts the light, the snare and high hits each tear the rows once with a hard RGB split, the prominent hits (16.8, 16.9) also open the contrast, and every two bars the hue sways a little. It settles into a loop.
